# Capri Destination Management Company (Capri DMC) — Complete B2B Dossier

## Overview & Profile
- Name: Capri Destination Management Company (Capri DMC)
- Heritage: Curated by Team Nesea (operating on Capri since 2010)
- Corporate Structure: 100% Women-Owned Enterprise
- Founding Team:

  - Roberta De Martino: Co-Founder & Lead Cultural Curator (Licensed art historian & island heritage researcher)
- Location: 80076 Capri, Metropolitan City of Naples, Campania, Italy (40.5507° N, 14.2426° E)
- Operations: On-Ground Island Dispatch & Resident Support (Always present and reliable: we live here)

## Core Motto & Brand Identity
- "Proudly Owned by Caprese People"

Capri DMC was engineered specifically to solve friction and operational challenges global luxury travel advisors experience when planning trips to Capri. By remaining 100% on-island and native, we eliminate third-party mainland markups and provide real-time on-ground dispatch.

## Comprehensive Service Catalog (11 Master B2B Offerings)

### 1. Capri Private Boat Services & Gozzo Charters
- Cluster: Exclusive Solutions
- Subtitle: Traditional Gozzo Caprese, Speedboats & Luxury Yacht Charters
- Category Badge: Boat Services
- B2B Advisor Advantage: Curated Boat Services
- Detailed Description: Through our trusted on-island maritime network, Capri DMC offers luxury travel advisors access to Capri's traditional wooden gozzo boats, speedboats, and private yacht charters. Our licensed native skippers navigate coastal waters and scenic coves, complemented by chilled champagne and tailored luxury catering onboard.
- Key B2B Operational Features:
  * Access to traditional Gozzo Caprese, speedboats, and private yacht charters upon request
  * Scenic Faraglioni dawn protocol & private coastal itineraries
  * Chilled champagne, prosecco, fresh seasonal fruit & tailored catering onboard
  * Flexible embarkation from Marina Grande or Marina Piccola

### 2. Private and Exclusive Transfer Services
- Cluster: Exclusive Solutions
- Subtitle: Naples-to-Capri Chauffeured Logistics & Island Luggage Coordination
- Category Badge: Private Transfers
- B2B Advisor Advantage: Seamless On-Ground Logistics
- Detailed Description: From arrival at Naples Capodichino (NAP) airport or rail hub, Capri DMC coordinates private transfers with luxury chauffeured cars or vans (NCC) and maritime crossings. Upon arrival on the island, iconic open-top convertible taxis are arranged on request through our trusted network, with dedicated luggage transport coordinated to deliver bags safely to private villas or hotel rooms following guest arrival.
- Key B2B Operational Features:
  * Personal meet & greet with private chauffeured car or luxury van (NCC) from Naples (NAP)
  * Coordinated maritime crossing to Capri with island greeting at Marina Grande
  * Dedicated luggage transport delivered to villas or hotel accommodations following guest arrival
  * Iconic open-top convertible taxis on request through our network, and private luxury vans

### 5. Exclusive Guided Island Tours
- Cluster: Custom Experiences
- Subtitle: Privileged Access Led by Certified Native Capresi Guides
- Category Badge: Guided Tours
- B2B Advisor Advantage: Heritage & Culture

Led by certified resident art historians and native guides from Team Nesea, guests bypass commercial queues to discover hidden courtyards, Roman imperial villas (Villa Jovis, Villa Damecuta), and private botanical terraces.

  * After-hours private access to Villa Lysis, Villa San Michele, and historic convents

  * Seamless integration with open-top taxi transfers and private refreshment stops

### 9. Hidden Hiking Excursions & Secret Nature Routes

From the dramatic Sentiero dei Fortini coastal trail to Mount Solaro ridges, ancient hermitages, and secret sea lookouts, our naturalist guides provide an exclusive encounter with Capri's raw Mediterranean wilderness.

  * Private cliffside gourmet picnics with local wines and panoramic views
  * Option to combine coastal hiking with private speedboat return pick-up

## VIP Logistics Architecture: From Arrival to Destination
1. Airport Meet & Greet: Dedicated greeting upon arrival at Naples International Airport (NAP), fast-track luggage assistance, private chauffeured NCC car or van transfer to the port.
2. Private Maritime Crossing: Direct private chartered speedboat or gozzo crossing across the Gulf of Naples with chilled champagne and refreshments onboard.
3. Open-Top Taxi & Island Van: On arrival, guests step into open-top convertible island taxis (available on request through our network) or private vans.
4. Dedicated Luggage Delivery: Dedicated island porterage transports all luggage securely from the dock, arriving comfortably following guest arrival at their private villa or hotel suite.
